notes: The Rolle/Darboux argument is valid under the added twice-differentiability assumption and avoids the reversed-limit pitfall. However, it proves only a strengthened-hypothesis version of the stated claim. Integrability alone is insufficient: for f(x)=|x| on [-1,1] with n=1, the trapezium error is 1, whereas f'' is zero wherever it exists and undefined at 0, so no required ξ exists.
